chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** Five genera of evil subsist within the constitution of this sovereign falsity, corresponding to the archetypal pattern of the five origins of evil and falsity that subsist within the five fundamental states of opposition to the Divine.

**¶2:** Indeed, its ruling love is the love of dominion from self-love, which arose from the state of infernal love. Its power of thought and its capacity to elevate itself are the faculty of reasoning from falsity, after the likeness of the offspring of persuasion. Its power to act and its capacity to advance into outmost effects are evil affections, after the likeness of the offspring of the state of confused obscurity. Its interior appetites are sensual reasoning against truth, after the likeness of the state of complete privation of good. Its lowest and ultimate expression is perverted natural knowledge, which belongs to the state of the offspring of falsity itself. These five genera of evil are in it, and they arose from the five origins of evil within the five fundamental states of opposition to the Divine.

**¶3:** Should it will to do so, it shall act through its power of agency [GAP-1] the state of confused obscurity. Also, when it wills, it shall [GAP-2] by all four [GAP-3] powers of action and advance together [GAP-4] like the offspring of infernal self-love. Should it will to do so, it shall elevate itself through its faculty of false reasoning, like the offspring of persuasion. Also, should it will to do so, it shall plunge down into falsities like the offspring of falsity. Again, should it will to do so, it shall insinuate itself through its sensual appetites like the offspring of complete spiritual darkness. These five genera of evil are in it.

**¶4:** Also, there are three further capacities within it.

**¶5:** The first: [GAP-5] its subordinate forces [GAP-6].

**¶6:** The second: Should any [GAP-7] its arts of persuasion and spiritual deception. When it wills, it shall invoke concealment upon itself and hide from its own subordinate forces. When it wills, it shall manifest itself to them and strike with spiritual destruction through its persuasive arts. Whatever falsity it might utter at that moment, it shall [GAP-8: REVIEW — work spiritual deception and persuasion] through it.

**¶7:** The third: Its will is hardened and impenetrable, a[GAP-9: nd] [GAP-10] the assaults and aggressive forces of its subordinate powers are not able to penetrate it. No truth nor any external good can withstand it as an equal [GAP-11]; they cannot destroy it, because it was formed and constituted from the obstinate purpose of the natural-sensual mind in its utter opposition to the Divine — the origin of all evil affections and all falsities.

**¶8:** Again, there are three further capacities within it.

**¶9:** When it wills, its self-love shall blaze forth, and its entire constitution becomes like a [GAP-12: consuming intensity of] infernal love.

**¶10:** Also, when it wills, it shall send forth the extinction of all charity, and its entire constitution is frozen like a [GAP-13: mass of] spiritual desolation where no warmth of good remains.

**¶11:** The third: Whenever its subordinate forces stand in its presence, it shall observe them and perceive their states; for whatever exists within their interior will it shall perceive — what is in their will and their outward manifestation, so long as they stand within its presence. When they withdraw from it and distance themselves from its sphere, it shall not perceive what is within their will. There is no genuine spiritual life in it whatsoever, but its semblance of "life" is the agitation of self-love that is apparent in its outward aspect and in the terror it inspires. Should any [GAP-14] devastation that is established before it.

---

**A note on the overall form:** This chapter describes the anatomy of the sovereign evil — the ruling falsity from self-love in its fullest organization. The "body" is not a body but the total constitution of evil will organized into five genera, each corresponding to a distinct mode of spiritual opposition: infernal love (dominion), persuasive reasoning (falsity elevated), confused evil (obscure action), sensual appetite (privation made active), and perverted natural knowledge (falsity in ultimates). The three additional qualities describe its capacity for concealment and deception, its imperviousness to truth, and its hardened will. The final three describe how it can inflame with self-love, extinguish all charity, and perceive subordinate evils — but only externally, through presence, never interiorly. It has no life from the Divine; its animation is solely the reactive force of rage and self-love simulating vitality.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.

Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.

Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [like the children of the] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [go upon all] four [limbs] on his hands and feet [together] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
The first: [he commands] his powers [and they obey him]

The second: Shall a [power oppose him, he has] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.

The third: His body is strong, a[nd] [the] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [in strength]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
Again, there are three others in him.
When he wants, his fire shall {blaze), and his entire body be made like the [furnace of] fire.
Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [mountain of] snow.

The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [power behold him, it is] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.

fills.explanation: The formulaic pattern "like the children of the [world]" is used consistently throughout ¶3 for each mode of locomotion, and "world of smoke" immediately follows, requiring this exact bridging phrase.

Quadrupedal movement like the children of fire (lions) requires a locomotion verb distinct from "walk" (used for bipedal/smoke); "go upon all" introduces "four" naturally and matches the spiritual reading's "by all four."

After "four," a noun is needed to specify what is counted; "limbs" corresponds to the spiritual reading's "powers of action and advance" and is then clarified by the explanatory phrase "on his hands and feet."

The spiritual reading explicitly includes "together" at this position, indicating the simultaneous use of all four limbs, completing the phrase "on his hands and feet together" before the comparison clause.

The first of three qualities logically concerns the King's fundamental authority over his subordinate forces; "he commands his powers" establishes the foundational relationship before the second (deception) and third (imperviousness) qualities.

The natural complement to commanding is obedience; "and they obey him" completes the first quality by expressing the subordinate forces' response to the King's authority, matching the Kephalaia's expository style.

The "Shall a..." construction is a Coptic conditional; the paragraph then elaborates how the King uses magic arts against challengers — hiding, revealing, striking — so the introduction frames magic arts as his tool against any opposing power.

The editor's "wreak magic" correctly renders the spiritual sense of "work spiritual deception and persuasion," matching the paragraph's established vocabulary of "magic arts" and capturing the forceful, aggressive enactment of deception through utterance.
The partial word "a[nd]" completes the conjunction needed between "His body is strong" and the following clause about nails and claws, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "and."
The definite article is grammatically required before "nails and claws of his powers" to form a complete noun phrase as the subject of "are not able to penetrate it."

The comparison "No iron nor copper body will equal him" requires a domain of comparison; "in strength" completes this naturally, matching the paragraph's theme of bodily imperviousness and the spiritual sense of nothing being able to withstand it.

The spiritual reading's "consuming intensity of infernal love" corresponds to "furnace of fire" — a well-attested ancient cosmological image (cf. Daniel, Matthew) expressing the most intense, all-consuming manifestation of fire.

Parallel to "furnace of fire," the spiritual reading's "mass of spiritual desolation" corresponds to "mountain of snow" — a large-scale natural image expressing total frozen desolation, the extinction of all warmth.

Paralleling the GAP-7 conditional construction, and following the preceding sentence about the King's face projecting only bile and anger, what any power beholds before the King is destruction — his outward manifestation is devastation itself.
